verdict.rationale: Airweave supports natural-language search via its MCP server, CLI, and skills for agents (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.), letting AI-native users query data conversationally rather than via rigid syntax. However, most of the evidence describes agent/tool-level natural-language search rather than a full natural-language command interface for setup, configuration, or administration tasks. missing for 10: evidence of NL commands controlling non-search operations (e.g., configuring connectors, managing collections via conversational commands), independent hands-on validation of NL command reliability.
